explanation: Generated a 3x3 grid of kinematic points for the eta channel (W = 1.55, 1.65, 1.75 GeV; Q2 = 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 GeV^2) at cos(theta*) = 0 and phi* = 90 deg. All 9 points passed preflight checks (production threshold, cos(theta*) pole safety, Q2 positivity, beam-energy accessibility, lookup-table coverage, phi range, vcut sanity) with no warnings or failures. A single input file was written since all points fit within one 10-point chunk, accompanied by manifest.csv.
